summary.en: Ukrainian naval drones have struck two Russian vessels at Libya's Benghazi naval base and off its coast, sinking one warship and damaging another. Libyan forces continue shelling Haftar positions while some Haftar militia have surrendered at a strategic airbase, and Turkish officials have publicly welcomed a motion supporting the troops. An armed group blocked the Hamada oil pipeline for over 20 days, causing $31 million in losses for the National Oil Corporation. The conflict still recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Ukrainske marine-droner har rammet to russiske fartøyer ved den libyske havn i Benghazi og utenfor kysten, senket ett krigsskip og skadet et annet. Libyske styrker fortsetter å skyte mot Haftar-posisjoner mens noen Haftar-milits har overgitt seg på en strategisk flybase, og tyrkiske tjenestemenn har offentlig ønsket en bevegelse som støtter troppene. En væpnet gruppe blokkerte Hamada-oljerørledningen i over 20 dager, noe som førte til tap på 31 millioner dollar for National Oil Corporation. Konflikten registrerte fortsatt to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Libyan crisis
background.extract: The Libyan crisis is the current humanitarian crisis and political-military instability occurring in Libya, beginning with the Arab Spring protests of 2011, which led to two civil wars, foreign military intervention, and the ousting and killing of Muammar Gaddafi. The first civil war's aftermath and proliferation of armed groups led to violence and instability across the country, which erupted into renewed civil war in 2014. The second war lasted until 23 October 2020, when all parties agreed to a permanent ceasefire and negotiations.
